_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 058bad52 (RFC 9821a379 AC10, founder's decision 2026-10-30): the indexer announces a deletion that changed the store, AFTER the change — after the in-flight rebuild (dropping the triples it read of the deleted file, unless the path came back), after the rebuild a deleted reified statement or FileSpace declaration needs; not a deletion of a file without triples, not an edit; unsubscribe is per listener; a failing listener is contained. `notifyFileRemoved` iterates a copy of the set (a listener added during a notification is not called by it) — defensive, no mutant.

DM1_announced_before_removal._note: Announcing before the removal can only be unconditional — the gate is the removal's own result — so every axis that wants the announcement after the change, or none at all, reddens. D12 reddens by mechanism: it combines a rebuild in flight with a deleted reified statement, so the announce order, the wait for the rebuild, the purging rebuild and the after-rebuild branch all meet in it. D13 reddens by the same mechanism for a deleted FileSpace declaration. D14 reddens by mechanism: a reified statement re-created during the rebuild is kept and not announced only after the wait and the «path exists again» check.

DM2_rebuild_not_awaited._note: Without the wait the removal runs inside the rebuild window: removed and announced before the rebuild settles (D2, D9), and before the path is re-created (D10). D12 reddens by mechanism: it combines a rebuild in flight with a deleted reified statement, so the announce order, the wait for the rebuild, the purging rebuild and the after-rebuild branch all meet in it. D14 reddens by mechanism: a reified statement re-created during the rebuild is kept and not announced only after the wait and the «path exists again» check.
